title: Reconcile historical done statuses with the configured closed workflow
description: Baseline origin/develop and reconciled board fail identically on four historical done statuses: virt-3134b694, virt-384faa72, virt-6f5b5e4b, virt-ccf3d867. Correct through Kanbus in separate scoped board maintenance; do not reopen the completed 0.6.1 cloud release. Current reconciliation adds no new validation errors.
